package filters

// TrackFilters contains filter criteria for tracks.
type TrackFilters struct {
	ID         *string
	Slug       *string
	Status     *int
	Title      *string
	ActiveOnly bool
}

// CourseLevelFilters contains filter criteria for course levels.
type CourseLevelFilters struct {
	ID         *string
	Slug       *string
	TrackID    *string
	Status     *int
	Title      *string
	ActiveOnly bool
}

// CourseGroupFilters contains filter criteria for course groups.
type CourseGroupFilters struct {
	ID         *string
	Slug       *string
	LevelID    *string
	Status     *int
	Title      *string
	ActiveOnly bool
}
